read_length_basis: modal sequence length over the first 100000 records of each mate. Read length is the one recognition wall this project has measured moving (SPEC 4.2), so it is recorded rather than assumed comparable to another library's.
block_basis: derived from the 32125614 pairs counted in this file: the largest round stride that fits 5 disjoint contiguous blocks of 200000 pairs with a 10% margin, so a file that counts shorter than its metadata still reads five blocks rather than leaving the last seeds empty.

not_measurable_from_the_file.trim_r2: needs the reads mapped onto known sequence; see experiments/nontemplate_prefix_map.py and trim_from_prefix.py
not_measurable_from_the_file.sample: the matrix, place, collection date and molecule are properties of the water and of the deposit, not of the FASTQ
not_measurable_from_the_file.crossplant_panel: membership of a committed panel, not a property of the reads
